user_decision.question: applyView's swallowed error (FormalSystem/Tactic/FormulaViews.lean:106-107) has no owner whose declared scope reaches it. proof_mode_error_message_coverage's remit is stated by path as 'every throwError path in FormalSystem/Automation/ProofMode/', which does not reach the FormalSystem/Tactic/ modules PR #7 created; proof_mode_views_tier obliges only a test of the message as it stands, which would freeze the wrong message in place; and reconcile_records_and_tasks_after_pr_review_round does not list proof_mode_error_message_coverage among the descriptions it will restate. Should proof_mode_error_message_coverage be widened to cover FormalSystem/Tactic/ and to require that swallowed errors are rewritten rather than merely tested, or should that obligation be added to proof_mode_views_tier instead?
options: Widen proof_mode_error_message_coverage's path scope to FormalSystem/Tactic/ and restate its remit to cover rewriting a swallowed error, not only testing the message it currently emits.
Add the obligation to proof_mode_views_tier, which already owns FormulaViews.lean, as an explicit deliverable alongside its existing wrong-shape-message test.
Add proof_mode_error_message_coverage to the list of task descriptions reconcile_records_and_tasks_after_pr_review_round restates, and let that task decide.
user_decision.recommendation: Add proof_mode_error_message_coverage to reconcile_records_and_tasks_after_pr_review_round's restatement list. That task is already contracted to re-scope six sibling descriptions against the merged tree and to re-measure the throwError counts PRs #7 and #8 added, so it is the cheapest place to settle both the path widening and the test-versus-rewrite question together, rather than this close-out guessing at a remit change.

sapience_notes.subject: Scope hole between BimodalLogic's proof-mode task descriptions
sapience_notes.value: proof_mode_error_message_coverage states its remit by path as FormalSystem/Automation/ProofMode/, which does not reach the FormalSystem/Tactic/ modules (FormulaSyntax, FormulaPositions, FormulaViews) that PR #7 created; and reconcile_records_and_tasks_after_pr_review_round's restatement list names six sibling tasks but not proof_mode_error_message_coverage. A path-stated remit silently fails to follow new modules into a new directory - worth checking whenever a contribution adds a directory.

sapience_notes.subject: verify-touched.sh behaviour on a shared, concurrently-dispatched tree
sapience_notes.value: It derives touched paths from the whole working tree, so sibling dispatches' uncommitted specs/TODO.md, specs/events.jsonl and specs/state.json are attributed to the running dispatch and pull in the entire 90-suite agent-system battery even for a three-file markdown edit. It also cannot see a git-excluded path at all (specs/reviews/ is excluded at .git/info/exclude:20), so such edits are invisible to it in both directions. In this deploy-only tree the resulting failures are a standing baseline: test-roadmap-generation.sh fails with 'roadmap-integration.sh not found (mode=source-store)' because there is no on-disk agent-system/ source store.

sapience_notes.subject: Confirming a markdown-only close-out did not regress Lean invariants
sapience_notes.value: Comparing the sorry/vacuous/axiom census against the pre-task commit with 'git grep -c' at a named revision is cheaper and more honest than running a build when the dispatch edited no .lean file. Here vacuous held at 1 and axioms at 12 across 8a813bbd8..HEAD, and the single vacuous hit (int_domain_universal := trivial at FormalSystem/Examples/TemporalStructures.lean:495) is a legitimate proof rather than a placeholder - a reminder that the vacuous-pattern grep has a real false-positive class.
